name: new_bank_v1_independent_feature_screen
implementation: new_bank_v1.py; independent numerical implementation, no historical-code equivalence claim

families.scale_pattern: per-channel RMS divided by root-mean-square of channel RMS; no amplitude coordinate
families.ring_lag: moving-RMS envelope with 25 ms width; correlation mean and standard deviation for circular lags 1..floor(C/2)
families.correlation_spectrum: descending nonnegative eigenvalues of moving-RMS-envelope channel correlation, normalized to sum one
families.frequency_direction: Hann-windowed mean-removed FFT; four equal-width bands from min(20,0.1*Nyquist) to min(450,0.95*Nyquist); L2-normalized channel power vector per band

baseline: existing F0 LocalDetailFamily fitted on source only; not an attempt to recover historical B0
common_classifier: StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924, fitted on source trials only
trial_aggregation: mean of at most eight nonoverlapping native 200ms windows; split before windowing
selection_rule: No definition, bands, envelope width, subjects, conditions, arms or hyperparameters changed after outcome inspection. Validation-best arm identified before interpreting final arm rankings.
scope: Exploratory forward feature development; not old X1-H/RLCS/CES/Frequency reproduction, not own-device live recognition.
